name: vscode-maven
description: Manage Maven projects, execute goals, generate project from archetype, improve user experience for Java developers.
readme:
# Maven for Java

The MAVEN section in the Explorer: projects, lifecycle goals, plugins and dependencies. Goals run in the terminal. Completion, hover and Go to Definition in `pom.xml`, Effective POM, and New Project from an archetype. Needs `mvn` in PATH or in `maven.executable.path`; a JDK for Maven itself.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

works: The MAVEN tree: multi-module projects, Lifecycle, Plugins, Dependencies, Favorites, refresh
Goals from the tree menu and from Execute Commands: terminal, history, favorites, custom goals
pom.xml: completion from Maven Central, hover, Go to Definition, Add a dependency quick fix
Effective POM, and New Project and New Module from an archetype, with Back between the steps
limits: Debug in the plugin goal menu does not start a debugger: Diode has none
Inserted pom.xml snippets have no tab stops and keep the indentation of the snippet itself: Diode has no snippet session
The Maven entry of the Java Projects view is not shown: that menu belongs to another extension
